project_type: Private single-tenant AWS agent operator platform. Python 3.11+ enforcement core (services/amazai/, no AWS calls in most of it), Lambda handlers (services/handlers/), CDK/TypeScript single stack (infra/), React/Vite console (web/, no UI framework).
build_system: venv + pip for Python; npm for infra and web. Python 3.11 is a hard floor: code parses its own '...Z' timestamps with datetime.fromisoformat which only accepts that suffix from 3.11. In this sandbox python3.11 lives at /root/.pyenv/versions/3.11.15/bin/python3.11 (the pyenv shim `python3.11` is NOT on PATH; use the full path to build the venv). Default `python3` is 3.9 and must NOT be used to run tests.
test_framework: pytest with moto (tests/conftest.py provides `table`, `store`, `two_stores` fixtures backed by moto mock_aws). Store tests assert ownerId isolation on one shared table. Handler tests monkeypatch api.Store to bind the moto table and stub _provision_harness/_schedule.
build_command: infra: cd infra && npm ci && npx cdk synth ; web: cd web && npm ci && npm run build
test_command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q  (venv built with /root/.pyenv/versions/3.11.15/bin/python3.11 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements-dev.txt). Env: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=testing AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=testing AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-west-2 (conftest sets defaults).
verification_instructions: 1) .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q  2) cd infra && npx cdk synth > /dev/null  3) cd web && npm run build && test -f dist/index.html. All three are what CI runs. Nothing is ever deployed to AWS; CI holds no credentials.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. web/dist is a build artifact (gitignored). No fixtures regenerated by build.
setup_instructions: /root/.pyenv/versions/3.11.15/bin/python3.11 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements-dev.txt ; cd infra && npm ci ; cd web && npm ci
environment_constraints: Network mode OPEN_INTERNET (installs work). NOTHING is deployed to AWS and no AWS credentials exist; all validation is local via pytest+cdk synth+web build. moto/boto3 toolchain drift: on clean `main` in this sandbox, 3 tests in tests/test_gaps_api.py FAIL (test_activity_after_the_marker_makes_it_unread_again, test_only_actual_files_are_listed_not_sealed_runs, test_files_are_newest_first) with botocore ResourceNotFoundException. Cause is those 3 tests construct a bare Store('owner-a') without binding the moto `table` fixture, and the installed boto3 1.43 / moto 5.2.3 combination does not intercept that lazily-created default resource. This is PRE-EXISTING and unrelated to this task. Do NOT try to fix those 3; treat 730 passed / 3 failed as the green baseline and ensure no NEW failures are introduced.
contribution_requirements: CLAUDE.md 'Conventions that are load-bearing' are mandatory: (1) Enforcement is code, never prompt — authz decisions live in services/amazai/, a capability a principal lacks is ABSENT not present-and-refused; if you reach for a system-prompt rule to make something safe, it belongs in policy.py/router.py. (2) The subject comes from the verified token, never from the request (identity.py). (3) Every row carries ownerId; every read/write filters on it (store.py). (4) Evidence/audit is append-only, never rewritten, and survives deletion of what it describes. (5) Approvals are argument-bound and expire to DENIED. Style: match surrounding code; comments explain WHY not WHAT; tests assert behaviour that would actually regress.
key_patterns: identity.Principal.org_id today returns user_id ('One workspace per owner today. A seam, not a promise.'). identity.ensure_user creates USER#<sub>/META rows (entity 'User', gsi1pk 'USERS'). identity.assert_owner is the single server-side gate, driven by OWNER_SUBJECTS/OWNER_EMAILS env (open when both empty). agents.Actor(user_id, org_id, agent_id) carries the caller; agents.Actor.is_agent distinguishes human vs agent; rule 2 = an agent is never the actor on a grant/budget change. agents.audit_event(agent_id, action, actor, before/after/detail) writes append-only AUDIT#<iso>#<suffix> rows under the agent partition with gsi1pk 'AUDIT'. policy.evaluate(tool, capability, preapproved) is the pre-model chokepoint with non-removable ALWAYS_APPROVE floor, NEVER_APPROVABLE, NEVER_PREAPPROVABLE, and Refused. keys.py is the single source of pk/sk shapes — add new key builders there, never hand-build keys in handlers. store.Store enforces ownerId on get/query/put/update/delete and supports transact_put for atomic multi-row writes. handlers/api.py is one Lambda dispatching on path via _match(); _principal(event) verifies the token then calls identity.assert_owner; _actor(event) builds an Actor. Errors map to HTTP: A.ValidationError->400, A.Escalation/PermissionError->403, A.QuotaExceeded/Conflict->409, NotFound->404.
relevant_files: services/amazai/identity.py (Principal, org_id seam, ensure_user, assert_owner, OWNER_SUBJECTS/OWNER_EMAILS) — primary extension point for principal state + membership
services/amazai/store.py (ownerId enforcement, transact_put) — pattern to follow, likely unchanged
services/amazai/policy.py (evaluate + floor) — the enforcement chokepoint the kill switch and principal-state gate must thread through
services/amazai/agents.py (Actor, audit_event, ValidationError/QuotaExceeded/Escalation, plan_update) — the audit + actor + role-check patterns to mirror for admin actions
services/handlers/api.py (routing, _principal, _actor, error mapping) — where admin routes and enforcement wiring plug in
services/amazai/settings.py (owner preferences row) — pattern for an org-scoped settings/killswitch row
docs/architecture/03-data-model.md (§ The multi-user seam: ORG#<orgId> + MEMBER#<sub> rows carrying a role; ownerId becomes orgId; agents gain visibility) — authoritative intended shape
docs/architecture/10-approvals-and-evidence.md (approvals + evidence; admin audit is DISTINCT from per-run evidence but shares a correlation id)
docs/architecture/02-control-plane-ia.md (console IA; admin surface must have NO bot chat composer)
tests/conftest.py (moto fixtures), tests/test_identity.py (Principal/owner allowlist tests), tests/test_agents.py, tests/test_policy.py, tests/test_agents_api.py (route test patterns)
.env.example (VITE_OWNER_SUB / VITE_OWNER_EMAIL owner seam), web/src (React console; admin surface is a separate route/origin with no composer)
directory_structure: BUILD_PLAN.md=spec; CLAUDE.md=conventions; docs/architecture/00-19=one doc per layer; infra/=CDK single stack (infra/lib/amazai-stack.ts, ~72-77 resources); services/amazai/=enforcement core (no AWS in most); services/handlers/=api/ws/orchestrator/routine/sweeper Lambdas; tests/=pytest+moto; web/=Vite React console; scripts/=doctor/deploy/resolve_models/provision_agents.
